**Part 2 checkpoint**

Asset security

*What you keep, how you label it and how you get rid of it.*

This checkpoint brings together the cases of Part 2: ch04, ch05. It replays each case as its real exhibit, asks the learner to recall where the control belonged and which of the eight questions it turned on, and adds exam-style practice.

EXAM-STYLE PRACTICE

The practice scenarios in a checkpoint are imagined, written for this course in the style of a CISSP scenario question. They must be labelled imagined in the lesson. Their answers must follow from the deck lines below and from the cases of this part, not from outside material.
